description:
Vamana: Teen Kadam Mein Teen Lok! 👣

🔱 Vishnu Vamana dwarf avatar King Bali three steps

King Bali (Mahabali) conquered all three worlds. Vishnu appeared as Vamana (dwarf brahmin) and asked for three steps of land. Bali agreed. Vamana grew cosmic-sized — first step covered earth, second covered heavens, for the third Bali offered his own head. Vishnu placed his foot there and sent Bali to the underworld, making him the king there.

👉 Bali ki daanveerata — aaj ke kisi neta mein hai?
